info.title: CobaltumORM tool
info.description: Command-line migration management and explicit C# code generation for CobaltumORM.

options.name: --output
options.description:
Output directory for init or JSON file for schema
schema defaults to schema.generated.json in the migration project
Output directory for directory and library modes

options.description:

options.name: --framework
options.description:
Target framework for init or dotnet run
Framework for a newly created migration project

options.name: --provider
options.description:

options.name: --environment
options.description: Environment name (default: DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT or Production)

options.name: --settings
options.description: JSON settings file used instead of appsettings files

options.name: --no-build
options.description: Do not build the migration project

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show migration files, SQL, and final schema without changes

options.name: --write-schema
options.description: Write final schema JSON after migrations up

options.name: --version
options.description: Version for a new migration

options.name: --generated-namespace
options.description: Namespace for generated code (default: application RootNamespace + .Generated)

options.name: --create-migration-project
options.description: Create the missing migration project without replacing files

options.name: --output-mode
options.description:
intermediate (default), directory, or library
intermediate writes under the project obj directory
directory writes a durable directory you can check in
library writes a directory that compiles as its own project

options.name: --library-name
options.description: Name of the library project the tool writes

options.name: --no-restore
options.description: Do not restore before evaluating the project

options.name: --verbose
options.description:
Print the MSBuild command and its output
Inspect, doctor, and MCP options:

options.name: --format
options.description:
text (default) or json
--format is available only for inspect and doctor

options.name: --target
options.description:
auto (default), agents, claude, cursor, copilot, or all
auto creates .cobaltum/assistant.md, updates detected adapters,
and creates AGENTS.md when no adapter is present.
agents, claude, cursor, and copilot select their matching adapter.
all writes AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursor/rules/cobaltum.mdc,
and .github/copilot-instructions.md.
Re-running the same options changes only CobaltumORM-managed blocks
and reports unchanged files.

library writes a directory that compiles as its own project

options.name: --library-name
options.description: Name of the library project the tool writes

options.name: --no-restore
options.description: Do not restore before evaluating the project

options.name: --verbose
options.description:
Print the MSBuild command and its output
Inspect, doctor, and MCP options:

options.name: --format
options.description:
text (default) or json
--format is available only for inspect and doctor

options.name: --target
options.description:
auto (default), agents, claude, cursor, copilot, or all
auto creates .cobaltum/assistant.md, updates detected adapters,
and creates AGENTS.md when no adapter is present.
agents, claude, cursor, and copilot select their matching adapter.
all writes AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursor/rules/cobaltum.mdc,
and .github/copilot-instructions.md.
Re-running the same options changes only CobaltumORM-managed blocks
and reports unchanged files.
